Grab an Edge⬲ Athleticsuntrained
Manipulate
TriggerYou fall from or past an edge or handhold.
RequirementsYour hands are not tied.

When you fall off an edge, you can try to grab it and stop the fall. You must succeed at a Reflex save, usually at the Climb DC.

Critical SuccessYou grab the edge whether or not you have a hand free, and treat the fall as 30 feet shorter.
SuccessWith at least one hand free you grab the edge and treat the fall as 20 feet shorter.
Critical FailureYou continue to fall and take an additional 10 bludgeoning damage for every 20 feet already fallen.
Falling Damage
  • Up to 10 feet no damage
  • Each further 10 feet 1d6 bludgeoning damage
  • Into water half
